description_en: Creates a database account for a cluster
description_zh: 为集群创建数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-account --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --account-name test_accout --account-password Test_accout1 --account-type Normal --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account. The name must meet the following requirements:
Starts with a lowercase letter and ends with a lowercase letter or digit.
Contains only lowercase letters, digits, or underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号名称，需符合如下要求：
以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾。
由小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.
Must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include: `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
Must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号密码。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
特殊符号包含：`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the account.
Cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
Cannot exceed 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
账号描述。
不能以`http://`或者`https://`开头。
长度不超过256个字符
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the account. Valid values:
Normal: standard account.
Super: privileged account
parameters.help_zh:
账号类型。取值说明：
Normal：普通账号。
Super：高权限账号
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.
Clickhouse: wide table engine
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB MySQL引擎。
Clickhouse：宽表引擎
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud Resource Access Management (RAM) user IDs to attach. Currently, only one RAM user can be attached
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的阿里云RAM用户ID列表，当前仅支持绑定一个
parameters.name: ram_user_list
